title: GlobCoins
description: GlobCoin - this is a mod that allows you to trade in your online worlds with players
body:
GlobCoin - this is a mod that allows you to trade in your online worlds with players 

there are three types of coins (gold, silver, copper) 

coins can be dug up in caves, they are hidden from your eyes, but not from your pickaxe, there will be a bright light next to this stone. you can find such stones only from 63 to 0 block by Y
